ground_truth: The switch of the fan is not turned on
response:
Most likely the fan has no power — it’s plugged into an outlet that isn’t supplying electricity. Common causes and fixes:

- You plugged it into a switched outlet (Electric Switch & Outlet). The switch must be bumped/turned on for power to flow. Drop something on the switch or bump it with a part to turn it on.  
- You plugged it into a Laser‑Activated Plug. That plug only provides power when a laser of the matching color hits it. Add the correct laser (or use a normal electrical outlet instead).  
- You plugged it into a solar panel but there’s no light on the panel. Add a light source (flashlight, lava lamp, magnifying‑glass+light) or use a powered outlet.  
- You actually placed a different part (motor, mixer, etc.) instead of the electric fan. Double‑check the part image/name.

Fix: plug the fan into an always‑powered Electrical Outlet, or make sure the switch/laser/solar source supplying the outlet is activated. After that the fan will blow (flip it if you want the wind in the other direction).
